selectionNote: Visually inspected at thumbnail and 1400px preview sizes. Clean mountain-and-river composition, visible snow peaks, and autumn larches. This asset is preferable to people, road-gate foregrounds, and mislabeled Changping Valley photographs. The original photograph has naturally shaded areas; no brightening was applied.
